name: 3Worlds
description: 3Worlds is a simulation platform for ecosystem modelling that represents any ecosystem as a dynamic graph. It supports diverse models including food webs, population dynamics, landscape ecology, energy and material flows, and integrates multiple ecological techniques in a unified framework.
reputation: Specialized research platform gaining recognition for flexible, graph-based ecosystem simulations across multiple subfields.
notes: Grounded in the universal concept of the ecosystem; highly versatile but primarily research-oriented.
